title: Self-supervised pretraining for dermoscopic lesion segmentation with limited labels: A controlled comparison of initialisation strategies
mechanism: Controlled comparison: in a ResNet-34 U-Net, ImageNet init beats in-domain masked-reconstruction pretraining, and ImageNet followed by SSL lowers Dice.
adaptation: No arm. Independent replication of our MIM null on the same architecture; argues to stop R34 + pool-MIM variants and spend SSL budget on new objectives or backbones.
min_experiment: None; cite in the benchmark's pretraining section.
evidence: R: ISIC 2016, 765 SSL images, 12-94 labels, 5 seeds; ImageNet best at every budget in R34; SSL after ImageNet worse at 4 of 5 budgets.
prior_overlap: Same mechanism as our closed MIM100-PF line (R34, in-domain MIM after ImageNet): consistent with the null.
